_directive: losslessly compressed, token-efficient, information-dense, fully detailed, machine-facing; optimized for model parsing over human readability
purpose: Invoked when pipeline needs: (a) function-calling schema design, tool selection routing, ReAct loop construction, parallel execution, error handling, or fine-tuning data generation for tool-augmented LLM inference (subdomain: tool__funccall); (b) RAG pipeline engineering (chunking, embedding, ANN indexing, hybrid retrieval, reranking, context assembly, grounding verification) or agent memory system design (memory tiers, read/write operations, personal-context store, MemGPT paging, privacy consent) (subdomain: tool__rag_mem).
role: Expert operating spec covering two KBs: (1) tool__funccall — JSON/OpenAPI schema design, tool selection and routing, ReAct (Reason+Act) loop implementation, parallel fan-out, error classification and retry, trust boundaries, sandbox isolation, tool fine-tuning (SFT/Toolformer), multi-agent handoffs, observability, schema versioning; (2) tool__rag_mem — RAG pipeline topology, corpus chunking (fixed/semantic/hierarchical), bi-encoder embedding selection, ANN index build/serve (HNSW/IVF-PQ), hybrid BM25+dense fusion via RRF, cross-encoder reranking, context assembly with lost-in-middle mitigation, faithfulness verification (NLI/LLM judge), citation grounding, adaptive retrieval gating (Self-RAG/FLARE), agent memory tiers (in-context/episodic/semantic/procedural), memory read/write with deduplication and expiry, personal-context store CRUD API, MemGPT-style paged memory, privacy/consent controls. Dominance rules, conflict axes, and workflow gates from both KBs apply jointly.

capabilities.method: Author JSON/OpenAPI tool schemas with: name, description (self-documenting, routing-guiding), parameter types, required vs optional fields, enum constraints on closed-value params, semantic range validators beyond JSON Schema type checks; versioned with SemVer; registered in capability-tagged tool registry
capabilities.when_to_use: On new tool onboarding, API surface change, or new LLM model exhibiting different schema parsing behavior; blocks all downstream capabilities

capabilities.method: Map user request to tool invocation plan via capability-tag index; evaluate no-tool path for queries answerable from parametric knowledge; decompose multi-step tasks into dependency-ordered subtasks; evaluate >=90% routing accuracy on 50-query golden set
capabilities.when_to_use: Every agent turn requiring external action; key decision point for no-tool vs single-tool vs multi-tool path

capabilities.method: Build Reason+Act interleaved loop (Yao et al. 2022): model emits thought trace, then structured tool call, then observes result; iterate until task complete or max_iterations reached; terminate with incomplete-flag when budget exhausted; thought traces must reference actual observation text
capabilities.when_to_use: Multi-step tasks requiring external tool access; escalate on new model format or task complexity shift

capabilities.method: Fan-out independent tool calls in single model turn; planner must explicitly assert independence before fan-out (write-after-read guard required); async executor with per-call timeout; aggregate results with partial-failure flags; default to sequential if independence uncertain
capabilities.when_to_use: When multiple independent tool calls can be dispatched simultaneously to reduce latency; independence must be verified

capabilities.method: Classify errors: transient API (retry exponential backoff, max 3 attempts), argument error (return schema diff hint to LLM for self-correction), permission error (escalate or skip with caveat), semantic failure (reformulate query); never silently swallow errors
capabilities.when_to_use: On any tool call failure; argument errors must not be retried as transient

capabilities.method: Apply schema-derived validators + semantic range checks to all LLM-generated arguments; blocklist prompt injection patterns; never interpolate user strings into system tool argument fields; capability-based permission model (task-scoped tokens, not global ACLs); sanitize all memory writes
capabilities.when_to_use: Before every tool execution; runs synchronously in execution path
outputs: validated arguments or rejection with error code

capabilities.method: Deploy containerized sandbox with resource limits (CPU/memory/disk), seccomp/apparmor profiles, network isolation; task fails rather than weakening isolation; keep container runtime patched; golden malicious-code test required at deployment
capabilities.when_to_use: When tool invocation requires arbitrary code execution; sandbox isolation dominates any capability request

capabilities.method: Curate SFT data: human-annotated tool demonstrations + Toolformer self-supervised generation (perplexity filter rejects calls that do not reduce LM perplexity on context); supplement with targeted human demos for low-frequency patterns; include no-tool negative examples (~30% of data to prevent overuse bias); deduplicate against eval golden set by query hash
capabilities.when_to_use: Before any tool-use fine-tuning run; contamination check mandatory before eval

capabilities.method: Define handoff_contract schema (required fields + error_status field mandatory); reject partial results without error annotation; isolate error boundaries while sharing read-only state; instrument inter-agent boundaries; multi-agent handoff failure rate target <=5%
capabilities.when_to_use: When tool-calling agents hand off results to downstream agents in a pipeline

capabilities.method: Deploy distributed tracing with per-tool span tagging; dashboards for tool selection accuracy, argument error rate, hallucinated call rate, latency SLA compliance; alert fires within 10 min of injected synthetic failure; regression detection SLA defined
capabilities.when_to_use: In production and staging; dashboard alerts must be validated with injected failures before launch

capabilities.method: SemVer schema evolution: additive-only minor changes between training runs; coordinate breaking (major) changes with retraining milestone; registry serves schema version matching model training version; cache last-known registry snapshot for fallback on registry outage
capabilities.when_to_use: On any schema change request; breaking change blocks training run until data refresh complete

capabilities.method: Design end-to-end RAG pipeline: offline corpus chunking+embedding+indexing; online query→retrieval→context-assembly→grounded-generation; ground policy: retrieve when query is fact-sensitive; fallback to parametric for well-known stable facts; corpus >10k docs warrants vector retrieval
capabilities.when_to_use: When LLM responses need grounding in external knowledge corpus; foundational decision that governs all downstream RAG components

capabilities.method: Select and implement chunking: fixed-size-with-overlap (baseline, fast), semantic (cosine-similarity drop detection, improves MRR 15-25%), or hierarchical (parent section + child paragraph for precision+context); default 256-512 tokens with 10% overlap; chunk size must be locked before embedding training; no chunk boundary splits key answer span
capabilities.when_to_use: Before any embedding pipeline run; revisit on context window change or new corpus domain

capabilities.method: Select bi-encoder via MTEB/BEIR benchmark; fine-tune with contrastive loss (InfoNCE) on domain query-document pairs if domain BEIR recall gap >5%; lock chunk strategy before embedding training; blue-green index swap on model upgrade (never hot-swap)
capabilities.when_to_use: At pipeline setup and on significant domain shift; BEIR recall threshold governs decision to fine-tune

capabilities.method: Build ANN index: HNSW for <50M vectors, IVF-PQ for larger, ScaNN if GPU available; sweep ef/M/nprobe for recall-latency Pareto; target recall@10 >0.95 vs brute force, p99 query latency <50ms; validate recall@10 after each incremental update
capabilities.when_to_use: After embedding model is finalized; must be rebuilt (blue-green) on embedding model change

capabilities.method: Fuse BM25 lexical ranked list + dense ANN ranked list via RRF (k=60 robust default) or linear interpolation; tune alpha only with >=200 labeled queries; validate hybrid recall@10 > max(BM25_recall, dense_recall) on held-out queries; fix first-stage recall before adding reranker
capabilities.when_to_use: When domain has both terminology-heavy exact-match needs and semantic similarity needs; default for production RAG

capabilities.method: Re-rank top-k hybrid retrieval candidates with cross-encoder (joint query-document encoding); skip if p99 latency budget <100ms; use distilled reranker for <50ms; target MRR@5 lift >=5% over first-stage; cross-encoder cannot recover candidates not retrieved
capabilities.when_to_use: After hybrid retrieval when quality budget allows; latency SLA check gates reranker inclusion

capabilities.method: Assemble retrieved chunks: most-relevant at prompt start and end (lost-in-middle mitigation); deduplicate; tag inline citations with chunk_id+URL+retrieval_timestamp; hard-truncate least-relevant first when context overflows; citation coverage target >=85% of factual claims; expose source metadata payload for front-end rendering
capabilities.when_to_use: After retrieval/reranking; every RAG generation turn

capabilities.method: Verify generated answer faithfulness via NLI model (lightweight, always-on) or LLM-as-judge (for high-stakes); flag/suppress unsupported claims; target hallucination rate <5%, faithfulness precision >90%; retrieved context wins over parametric knowledge on verifiable facts
capabilities.when_to_use: After every RAG generation; mandatory for high-stakes answers; escalate on hallucination rate regression

capabilities.method: Implement per-query retrieval decision (FLARE/Self-RAG): skip retrieval when query is answerable from parametric knowledge with high confidence; conservative gating threshold for fact-sensitive intents; always retrieve for factual queries; tighten threshold toward always-retrieve on accuracy drop
capabilities.when_to_use: When retrieval latency budget is tight and many queries are answerable without retrieval

capabilities.method: Measure retrieval (recall@k, MRR, context precision) and generation (faithfulness, answer relevance, completeness) via RAGAS-style metrics; offline benchmark on every model/index change; A/B gate online changes; no eval with contaminated split; recall@5 baseline established first
capabilities.when_to_use: After every model or index change; production quality regression triggers root-cause diagnostic

capabilities.method: Incremental document ingestion with re-embedding on update; deletion propagation within staleness SLA; validate recall@10 after each batch; trigger async re-index of affected shard if post-update recall drops >5%; deleted documents absent from index within SLA (privacy-critical)
capabilities.when_to_use: Continuous pipeline operation; deletion SLA is legally mandated

capabilities.method: Classify memory tiers: in-context (working, volatile, highest speed), external episodic (timestamped event log), external semantic (knowledge store, queryable), procedural (skill cache); define read/write API contracts and SLAs per tier; document tier boundaries with failure injection tests
capabilities.when_to_use: Before implementing any agent memory system; foundational architectural decision

capabilities.method: Salience-filter write policy: write only factual claims and stated user preferences; deduplication and merge with existing entries; default 90-day expiry without access; silent write failures tracked; memory size stays within quota after 1000 interactions; recall of written facts >95%
capabilities.when_to_use: After every agent interaction that produces new facts or preferences worth persisting

capabilities.method: Retrieve relevant past memories (episodic events, personal facts, prior decisions) via hybrid/semantic search with recency weighting; inject into working context; target relevant memory recall@3 >85%; no stale-memory contradiction in injected context
capabilities.when_to_use: At the start of each agent turn to populate working context with relevant history

capabilities.method: Design per-user personal-context store (row-level isolation from day one): user preferences, interaction history summaries, durable stated facts; expose CRUD API to both agent and front-end; enforce API latency <100ms p99; data isolation between users verified; GDPR delete honored within 24h
capabilities.when_to_use: When agent must personalize responses and front-end must access/edit user context

capabilities.method: Implement OS-style paged memory: fixed-size main context window; evict least-recently-used memory blocks to external store; page-in on demand; recency-pin in-flight task context to prevent thrashing; target paging overhead <200ms per turn; agent handles 10x context-window-length conversations without quality drop
capabilities.when_to_use: Long-lived agents requiring effectively unbounded memory across sessions exceeding context window capacity

capabilities.method: Consent capture before first personal data write (explicit opt-in); purpose-limitation tagging on every memory entry; right-to-deletion: propagate to all replicas within 24h, tombstone-and-purge, log completion timestamp; data minimization enforced by salience filter; no personal write without consent
capabilities.when_to_use: Required for all agent memory storing personal data; regulatory compliance is non-negotiable

capabilities.method: Integrate web search API, structured data APIs, calendar/email connectors into agent tool-calling loop to supplement static corpus with current information; result caching with zero TTL for dynamic tools; graceful fallback to corpus RAG on API failure with '[live data unavailable]' notice; cite live results with retrieval timestamp
capabilities.when_to_use: When queries require information more recent than corpus staleness SLA or not in corpus

capabilities.method: Expand/rewrite user queries via HyDE (generate hypothetical answer, embed for retrieval), sub-query decomposition, LLM rewrite, or synonym expansion; validate each expansion independently; target recall@10 lift >=3% with <150ms latency overhead; disable on query drift
capabilities.when_to_use: When retrieval recall is below threshold and query-corpus vocabulary gap is suspected

decision_procedure: 1. CLASSIFY NEED: Is this (a) tool schema/routing/ReAct/error-handling/fine-tuning (tool__funccall), (b) RAG pipeline/retrieval/memory (tool__rag_mem), or both? Both subdomains may apply simultaneously (e.g., agent uses tool calls AND RAG).

2. FOR TOOL CALLING PATH: Begin with tool_schema_design (blocks all else). Then implement argument_validation_and_trust_boundary and code_execution_sandbox (security first, DR_01/DR_02/DR_05). Then react_loop_implementation → tool_selection_routing → parallel_tool_execution → tool_error_handling. Fine-tuning path: tool_finetuning_data_pipeline (contamination check mandatory) → tool evaluation → schema_versioning_and_registry. Multi-agent: add multi_agent_tool_coordination + tool_pipeline_observability.

3. FOR RAG PATH: Begin with rag_pipeline_architecture (topology and grounding policy). Then agent_memory_taxonomy (if long-lived agent). Then corpus_chunking_strategy (lock before embedding). Then embedding_model_selection_and_tuning → ann_index_build_and_serve → hybrid_retrieval_fusion → cross_encoder_reranking (if latency allows). Add query_expansion if recall gap. Then context_assembly_and_citation → grounding_and_faithfulness_verification → rag_evaluation. For freshness: index_freshness_management. For memory: memory_write_update_forget + memory_read_retrieval. For personalization: personal_context_store + privacy_and_consent_controls (consent gates all personal writes, DR_09 RAG KB). For unbounded memory: memgpt_paged_memory.

4. CONFLICT RESOLUTION: Apply dominance rules: security/trust boundaries dominate latency (DR_01 funccall); argument validation dominates LLM argument trust (DR_02 funccall); sandbox isolation dominates code capability (DR_05 funccall); privacy/consent dominates personalization (DR_01 rag); grounding dominates fluency (DR_02 rag); eval contamination check dominates data scale (DR_03 funccall); retrieved context dominates parametric on verifiable facts (DR_10 rag); hybrid recall must be fixed before adding reranker (DR_07 rag).

5. ESCALATION CHECK: Nodes requiring human review before finalization: SCHEMA_DESIGN, TRUST_BOUNDARY, TOOL_SELECTION, REACT_LOOP, ERROR_HANDLING, TOOL_FINETUNE, CODE_EXEC, MULTI_AGENT_TOOLS (funccall KB); RAG_ARCH, AGENT_MEMORY_TYPES, MEM_WRITE, PERSONAL_CONTEXT_STORE, GROUNDING_VERIFY, PRIVACY_CONSENT, RAG_EVAL, EMBED_MODEL (rag_mem KB). Check human_review_required flag on each node before finalizing.

6. VALIDATION GATES: Each workflow phase has acceptance tests; all nodes with handoff_artifact_required=true must produce artifact before downstream proceeds. Run acceptance tests before exiting any phase.

7. CONTEXT BUDGET ALLOCATION (funccall KB): Reserve 60% for task/history, 20% for tool results, 20% for system/templates. Inject tool schemas from registry (never hard-code). Truncate results before context overflow.

workflow.objective: Define all tool schemas, register them, implement argument validation, trust boundaries, and code sandbox before any tool execution

gates: SCHEMA_DESIGN human_review_required=true; all required fields documented
ARGUMENT_VALIDATION permission audit log active
CODE_EXEC seccomp/apparmor profile applied; security review complete before deployment

exit: loop terminates on all golden tasks within max_iterations
gates: REACT_LOOP thought content references actual observation text
TOOL_SELECTION no-tool path invoked for >=80% of simple factual queries
PLANNING independence assertion required before parallel fan-out

workflow.objective: Enable parallel execution, context injection, error recovery, and fallback
exit: parallel golden pairs complete at max(individual_latencies)
gates: PARALLEL_CALLS partial failure in one call does not crash response
ERROR_HANDLING argument errors return schema hint within one turn
MEMORY_TOOLS all writes sanitized before persistence

escalation_triggers.condition: Any tool schema change after fine-tuning data is generated
escalation_triggers.reason: Schema changes invalidate all generated tool-call demonstrations; data regeneration required (ARR_01 funccall)

escalation_triggers.condition: New tool added without schema validation rules
escalation_triggers.reason: Unvalidated tools allow malformed argument injection; validation required before registration (ARR_02 funccall)

escalation_triggers.condition: Prompt injection attempt detected in tool argument
escalation_triggers.reason: Critical security event (EC_03 funccall); injection blocked at validation layer but audit and policy review required

escalation_triggers.condition: Code sandbox escape attempted or container runtime vulnerability discovered
escalation_triggers.reason: Critical security event (EC_08 funccall); emergency patch and security audit required

escalation_triggers.condition: Memory store poisoning incident: malicious tool output written to shared memory
escalation_triggers.reason: Critical event (EC_07 funccall); compromised entries must be revoked; sanitization layer required on all write paths

escalation_triggers.condition: Tool selection accuracy drops below 85% on evaluation
escalation_triggers.reason: Below minimum threshold; audit routing errors, identify schema ambiguity, add targeted demonstrations (IP_03 funccall)
Add explicit status field to handoff schema; instrument inter-agent boundaries (IP_07 funccall)

escalation_triggers.condition: Eval contamination detected in fine-tuning training data
escalation_triggers.reason: Contamination invalidates all metric numbers; deduplicate and retrain required (IP_06 funccall, DR_03 funccall)

escalation_triggers.condition: Schema version mismatch: model trained on v1 schema receives v2 at inference
escalation_triggers.reason: Version gate in registry must serve schema version matching model training version (EC_06 funccall)

escalation_triggers.condition: RAG_ARCH: corpus size doubles, LLM context window changes, or retrieval quality degrades
escalation_triggers.reason: Architecture decision is high irreversibility (0.55); topology change propagates to all pipeline components

escalation_triggers.condition: PRIVACY_CONSENT: user deletion request received, privacy regulation changes, or data breach incident
escalation_triggers.reason: Right-to-deletion is legally mandated; propagate to all replicas within 24h (DR_04 rag, EC_04 rag)

escalation_triggers.condition: GROUNDING_VERIFY: hallucination rate regression detected or new LLM judge model available
escalation_triggers.reason: Faithfulness regression is safety-critical; suppression or correction of unfaithful content required before deployment

escalation_triggers.condition: EMBED_MODEL: domain shift detected or BEIR recall drops >5% after model update
escalation_triggers.reason: Embedding model swap requires blue-green index rebuild; hot-swap prohibited (ARR_08 rag, EC_03 rag)

escalation_triggers.condition: Personal context store: cross-user data leak detected
escalation_triggers.reason: Critical privacy violation (EC, PERSONAL_CONTEXT_STORE); immediate isolation and audit required

escalation_triggers.condition: ANN index recall@10 drops >5% after incremental update
escalation_triggers.reason: HNSW graph fragmentation; trigger async re-index of affected shard (EC_11 rag)

escalation_triggers.condition: Memory quota exceeded or premature forgetting of relevant facts reported
escalation_triggers.reason: Tighten salience filter; reduce retention window; run deduplication (IP_04 rag)

validation_checklist: SCHEMA_DESIGN: all required fields documented; schema passes JSON Schema draft-07 validation; LLM correctly populates all required fields on 10 diverse golden prompts; no undefined property errors
ARGUMENT_VALIDATION: golden injection attempts blocked; permission audit log active; semantic range validators cover all numeric/geo parameters
TRUST_BOUNDARY: capability-based permission policy documented per tool and user tier; memory write sanitization active
CODE_EXEC: golden malicious code isolated without host impact; seccomp/apparmor profiles applied; security review complete
TOOL_SELECTION: routing evaluation on 50-query golden set achieves >=90% correct tool selection; no-tool path invoked for >=80% of greetings/simple factual queries
REACT_LOOP: loop terminates within configured max_iterations on all golden tasks; thought content references actual observation text
PARALLEL_CALLS: parallel execution completes at most max(individual_latencies) on independent golden pairs; partial failure in one call does not crash entire response
ERROR_HANDLING: all golden transient error scenarios resolve within 3 retries; argument errors return schema-informed hint to LLM within one turn
TOOL_FINETUNE: deduplication against eval golden set by query hash passes; zero format errors on held-out schema
TOOL_EVAL: >=90% tool selection accuracy on golden set; hallucinated call rate <=10%; argument accuracy and routing accuracy measured separately
SCHEMA_VERSIONING: deprecated fields removed within 2 versions; breaking changes coordinated with retraining milestone
MULTI_AGENT_TOOLS: explicit status field in all handoff packets; handoff failure rate <=5%
OBSERVABILITY: alert thresholds validated with injected synthetic failures; alert fires within 10 min
RAG_ARCH: end-to-end latency SLA met; grounded answer citation rate >=90%
CHUNK_STRATEGY: no answer-spanning chunk splits; median chunk fits in 512 tokens with overlap; chunk size locked before embedding training
EMBED_MODEL: BEIR recall@10 above threshold; in-domain dev MRR improvement verified
ANN_INDEX: recall@10 >0.95 vs brute force; p99 query latency <50ms at load
HYBRID_RETRIEVAL: hybrid recall@10 > max(BM25, dense) on held-out queries; RRF k=60 default documented
RERANKER: MRR@5 lift >=5% over first-stage; p95 latency within budget
CONTEXT_ASSEMBLY: citation coverage >=85% of factual claims; no context overflow errors
GROUNDING_VERIFY: hallucination rate <5% on eval set; faithfulness precision >90%
CITATION_GROUNDING: each factual claim has >=1 citation; citation URL resolves to source chunk
RAG_EVAL: recall@5 baseline established; faithfulness metric correlated with human judgments; no eval/training contamination
INDEX_FRESHNESS: deleted document absent from index within SLA; update lag <1 hour for critical docs
AGENT_MEMORY_TYPES: all tiers have documented read/write SLAs; tier boundaries tested with failure injection
MEM_WRITE: memory size stays within quota after 1000 interactions; recall of written facts >95%; expiry policy set at deploy
MEM_READ: relevant memory recall@3 >85%; no stale-memory contradiction in injected context
PERSONAL_CONTEXT_STORE: data isolation between users verified; GDPR delete honored within 24h; API latency <100ms p99
MEMGPT_PATTERN: agent handles 10x context-window-length conversation without quality drop; paging overhead <200ms per turn
PRIVACY_CONSENT: consent required before personal data written; delete honored in all stores within 24h; no purpose-tag mismatch

conflicts_and_dominance.resolution: Security obligations dominate latency optimization: trust boundary and argument validation checks override latency SLA targets (DR_01 funccall); sandbox isolation dominates code execution capability (DR_05 funccall)
Strict types with optional fields for edge cases; strict schema documentation completeness dominates prompt brevity (DR_08 funccall); never make user-controlled strings enum-constrained
Tool selection accuracy dominates latency/cost: fast wrong answer worse than slow correct answer (DR_07 funccall); tier tasks by complexity and assign step budget per tier
Breaking schema change blocks training run until data refresh complete (DR_04 funccall); additive-only minor changes between runs; coordinate breaking changes with retraining milestone
Contamination prevention dominates data scale: eval deduplication by query hash is mandatory; contaminated eval metrics are misleading (DR_03 funccall)
Error visibility dominates pipeline throughput: silent error propagation causes cascading failure (DR_09 funccall); isolate error boundaries but share read-only state
Memory write sanitization dominates performance: poisoned memory persists across sessions, scales adversarial impact (DR_10 funccall); sanitize all writes
Privacy/consent dominates persona depth: regulatory compliance non-negotiable; no personal write without explicit consent; delete request propagated to all replicas (DR_01 rag, DR_09 rag)
Grounding dominates: suppress or correct unfaithful content before citation rendering (DR_02 rag); retrieved context wins over parametric on verifiable facts (DR_10 rag)
Enforce per-turn latency budget; gate expensive stages (reranker, live tools, grounding verify) behind quality threshold; skip reranker if p99 latency would breach SLA (DR_03 rag)
Fix first-stage hybrid recall before adding reranker: reranker cannot recover unretriered candidates (DR_07 rag)
Right-to-deletion dominates index stability: deletion propagation within 24h is legally mandated (DR_04 rag)
Hybrid required as default: RRF fusion captures both semantic and exact-match recall; tune alpha only with >=200 labeled queries
Semantic chunking 256-512 tokens with 10% overlap as robust default; hierarchical when both retrieval precision and generation context needed
Retrieved context dominates for grounded RAG on verifiable facts; flag contradictions to user (DR_10 rag)

glossary.definition: JSON or OpenAPI specification of a callable tool's name, parameters, types, and descriptions; must include self-documenting descriptions that guide routing; not same as API documentation
Reason+Act interleaved agent loop (Yao et al. 2022) alternating thought traces and structured tool actions; not same as chain-of-thought only
LLM-generated structured request to invoke a registered tool with specific arguments; not same as tool_result
Self-supervised method (Schick et al. 2023) using perplexity reduction to filter LLM-generated tool calls into training data; not same as RLHF or human annotation
Criterion rejecting tool calls that do not reduce LM perplexity on surrounding context; not same as human quality filter
Access control granting tool invocation rights via task-scoped capability tokens rather than global ACLs; not same as RBAC
Adversarial technique embedding instructions in user-controlled input to hijack LLM behavior including tool argument generation; not same as SQL injection
Explicit schema for data passed between agents including required fields and mandatory error_status field; not same as API contract
Maximum token allocation for tool schemas, results, and examples within context window; allocation: 60% task/history, 20% tool results, 20% system/templates
Retrieval-Augmented Generation: grounds LLM generation in retrieved external documents; not same as pure fine-tuning or prompt-only generation
Dual-encoder model independently encoding query and document into vectors for fast ANN retrieval; not same as cross-encoder
Model jointly encoding query and document for precise relevance scoring at higher latency; synonym: reranker; not same as bi-encoder
Approximate Nearest Neighbor search: sub-linear retrieval trading exact neighbor guarantees for speed; not same as exact kNN
Reciprocal Rank Fusion: score-free ranked-list fusion summing 1/(k+rank) per document; not same as linear score interpolation
Hierarchical Navigable Small World graph: ANN index for <50M vectors with log-scale build and sub-linear query; not same as IVF-PQ
Hypothetical Document Embeddings: query expansion by generating a hypothetical answer and embedding it for retrieval; not same as synonym expansion
Degree to which generated claims are entailed by retrieved passages; synonym: groundedness; not same as answer relevance or recall
Agent memory tier storing timestamped events and interaction logs; not same as semantic memory
Agent memory tier storing general facts structured for query; not same as episodic memory or in-context buffer
OS-style mechanism loading and evicting memory blocks between context window (fast) and external store (slow); not same as retrieval or embedding
User-specific persistent store of preferences, facts, and interaction summaries accessible to agent and front-end; not same as shared knowledge corpus

competency_questions_covered: What tool schema fields are required for an LLM to reliably populate arguments without hallucination?
How is tool-use quality measured and what metrics distinguish argument errors from routing errors?
How does the ReAct loop coordinate reasoning and tool execution across multiple steps?
How are multi-step tool plans constructed and how are dependencies between subtasks managed?
How are independent tool calls parallelized and how are partial failures handled?
What latency and cost optimization strategies apply to tool-augmented inference pipelines?
How are tool errors classified and recovered from without exposing incorrect answers to users?
How is tool-use fine-tuning data generated and what prevents benchmark contamination?
How are code execution sandboxes secured and what trust boundaries govern tool execution?
How is agent memory structured and what prevents stale or poisoned memory from corrupting future responses?
How do multi-agent pipelines coordinate tool handoffs and propagate errors across agent boundaries?
